verses.original: תְּפִלָּה֮ לְמֹשֶׁ֪ה אִֽישׁ־ הָאֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים אֲ‍ֽדֹנָ֗י מָע֣וֹן אַ֭תָּה הָיִ֥יתָ לָּ֗נוּ בְּדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: tə·p̄il·lāh lə·mō·šeh ’îš- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ăḏō·nāy mā·‘ō·wn ’at·tāh hā·yî·ṯā lā·nū bə·ḏōr wā·ḏōr
verses.literal: A prayer of Moses the man of God Lord You have been our dwelling place through all generations
verses.literalPt: SENHOR, tu tens sido o nosso refúgio, de geração em geração.

verses.original: בְּטֶ֤רֶם׀ הָ֘רִ֤ים יֻלָּ֗דוּ וַתְּח֣וֹלֵֽל אֶ֣רֶץ וְתֵבֵ֑ל וּֽמֵעוֹלָ֥ם עַד־ ע֝וֹלָ֗ם אַתָּ֥ה אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṭe·rem hā·rîm yul·lā·ḏū wat·tə·ḥō·w·lêl ’e·reṣ wə·ṯê·ḇêl ū·mê·‘ō·w·lām ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām ’at·tāh ’êl
verses.literal: Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world from everlasting to everlasting You are God
verses.literalPt: Antes que os montes nascessem, ou que tu formasses a terra e o mundo, mesmo de eternidade a eternidade, tu és Deus.

verses.original: תָּשֵׁ֣ב אֱ֭נוֹשׁ עַד־ דַּכָּ֑א וַ֝תֹּ֗אמֶר שׁ֣וּבוּ בְנֵי־ אָדָֽם׃
verses.literal: You return man to dust saying Return O sons of mortals
verses.literalPt: Tu reduzes o homem à destruição; e dizes: Tornai-vos, filhos dos homens.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֶ֪לֶף שָׁנִ֡ים בְּֽעֵינֶ֗יךָ כְּי֣וֹם אֶ֭תְמוֹל כִּ֣י יַעֲבֹ֑ר וְאַשְׁמוּרָ֥ה בַלָּֽיְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’e·lep̄ šā·nîm bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā kə·yō·wm ’eṯ·mō·wl kî ya·‘ă·ḇōr wə·’aš·mū·rāh ḇal·lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: For in Your sight a thousand years are but a day that passes or a watch of the night
verses.literalPt: Porque mil anos são aos teus olhos como o dia de ontem que passou, e como a vigília da noite.

verses.original: זְ֭רַמְתָּם שֵׁנָ֣ה יִהְי֑וּ בַּ֝בֹּ֗קֶר כֶּחָצִ֥יר יַחֲלֹֽף׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ram·tām šê·nāh yih·yū bab·bō·qer ke·ḥā·ṣîr ya·ḥă·lōp̄
verses.literal: You sweep them away in their sleep they are like the new grass . . . of the morning
verses.literalPt: Tu os levas como uma corrente de água; são como um sono; de manhã são como a erva que cresce.

verses.original: בַּ֭בֹּקֶר יָצִ֣יץ וְחָלָ֑ף לָ֝עֶ֗רֶב יְמוֹלֵ֥ל וְיָבֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: bab·bō·qer yā·ṣîṣ wə·ḥā·lāp̄ lā·‘e·reḇ yə·mō·w·lêl wə·yā·ḇêš
verses.literal: in the morning it springs up new but by evening it fades and withers
verses.literalPt: De madrugada floresce e cresce; à tarde corta-se e seca.

verses.literal: For we are consumed by Your anger and terrified by Your wrath
verses.literalPt: Pois somos consumidos pela tua ira, e pelo teu furor somos angustiados.

verses.original: שַׁתָּ עֲוֺנֹתֵ֣ינוּ לְנֶגְדֶּ֑ךָ עֲ֝לֻמֵ֗נוּ לִמְא֥וֹר פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.literal: You have set our iniquities before You our secret sins in the light of Your presence
verses.literalPt: Diante de ti puseste as nossas iniqüidades, os nossos pecados ocultos, à luz do teu rosto.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כָל־ יָ֭מֵינוּ פָּנ֣וּ בְעֶבְרָתֶ֑ךָ כִּלִּ֖ינוּ שָׁנֵ֣ינוּ כְמוֹ־ הֶֽגֶה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵāl yā·mê·nū pā·nū ḇə·‘eḇ·rā·ṯe·ḵā kil·lî·nū šā·nê·nū ḵə·mōw- he·ḡeh
verses.literal: For all our days decline in Your fury we finish our years with a sigh
verses.literalPt: Pois todos os nossos dias vão passando na tua indignação; passamos os nossos anos como um conto que se conta.

verses.original: יְמֵֽי־ שְׁנוֹתֵ֨ינוּ בָהֶ֥ם שִׁבְעִ֪ים שָׁנָ֡ה וְאִ֤ם בִּגְבוּרֹ֨ת׀ שְׁמ֘וֹנִ֤ים שָׁנָ֗ה וְ֭רָהְבָּם עָמָ֣ל וָאָ֑וֶן כִּי־ גָ֥ז חִ֝֗ישׁ וַנָּעֻֽפָה׃
verses.transliteration: yə·mê- šə·nō·w·ṯê·nū ḇā·hem šiḇ·‘îm šā·nāh wə·’im biḡ·ḇū·rōṯ šə·mō·w·nîm šā·nāh wə·rā·hə·bām ‘ā·māl wā·’ā·wen kî- ḡāz ḥîš wan·nā·‘u·p̄āh
verses.literal: The length of our days . . . is seventy years or eighty if we are strong . . . yet their pride is but labor and sorrow for they quickly pass and we fly away
verses.literalPt: Os dias da nossa vida chegam a setenta anos, e se alguns, pela sua robustez, chegam a oitenta anos, o orgulho deles é canseira e enfado, pois cedo se corta e vamos voando.

verses.original: מִֽי־ י֭וֹדֵעַ עֹ֣ז אַפֶּ֑ךָ וּ֝כְיִרְאָתְךָ֗ עֶבְרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.literal: Who knows the power of Your anger Your wrath matches the fear You are due
verses.literalPt: Quem conhece o poder da tua ira? Segundo és tremendo, assim é o teu furor.

verses.original: לִמְנ֣וֹת יָ֭מֵינוּ כֵּ֣ן הוֹדַ֑ע וְ֝נָבִ֗א לְבַ֣ב חָכְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lim·nō·wṯ yā·mê·nū kên hō·w·ḏa‘ wə·nā·ḇi lə·ḇaḇ ḥāḵ·māh
verses.literal: So teach us to number our days that we may present a heart of wisdom
verses.literalPt: Ensina-nos a contar os nossos dias, de tal maneira que alcancemos corações sábios.

verses.original: שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה עַד־ מָתָ֑י וְ֝הִנָּחֵ֗ם עַל־ עֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.literal: Return O LORD How long will it be . . . Have compassion on Your servants
verses.literalPt: Volta-te para nós, SENHOR; até quando? Aplaca-te para com os teus servos.

verses.original: שַׂבְּעֵ֣נוּ בַבֹּ֣קֶר חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וּֽנְרַנְּנָ֥ה וְ֝נִשְׂמְחָ֗ה בְּכָל־ יָמֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: śab·bə·‘ê·nū ḇab·bō·qer ḥas·de·ḵā ū·nə·ran·nə·nāh wə·niś·mə·ḥāh bə·ḵāl yā·mê·nū
verses.literal: Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days
verses.literalPt: Farta-nos de madrugada com a tua benignidade, para que nos regozijemos, e nos alegremos todos os nossos dias.

verses.original: שַׂ֭מְּחֵנוּ כִּימ֣וֹת עִנִּיתָ֑נוּ שְׁ֝נ֗וֹת רָאִ֥ינוּ רָעָֽה׃
verses.literal: Make us glad for as many days as You have afflicted us for as many years as we have seen evil
verses.literalPt: Alegra-nos pelos dias em que nos afligiste, e pelos anos em que vimos o mal.

verses.original: יֵרָאֶ֣ה אֶל־ עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ פָעֳלֶ֑ךָ וַ֝הֲדָרְךָ֗ עַל־ בְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.literal: May Your work be shown to Your servants and Your splendor to their children
verses.literalPt: Apareça a tua obra aos teus servos, e a tua glória sobre seus filhos.

verses.original: וִיהִ֤י׀ נֹ֤עַם אֲדֹנָ֥י אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עָ֫לֵ֥ינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָ֭דֵינוּ כּוֹנְנָ֥ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָ֝דֵ֗ינוּ כּוֹנְנֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wî·hî nō·‘am ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ‘ā·lê·nū ū·ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏê·nū kō·wn·nāh ‘ā·lê·nū ū·ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏê·nū kō·wn·nê·hū
verses.literal: May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us establish for us the work of our hands yes, establish the work of our hands
verses.literalPt: E seja sobre nós a formosura do SENHOR nosso Deus, e confirma sobre nós a obra das nossas mãos; sim, confirma a obra das nossas mãos.
